tests.title: The 3+ category holds 50 questions, each with one answer in Polish and English

steps.action: Read the decks the app ships
steps.expected: A 3+ deck is among them

steps.action: Count the questions of the 3+ deck
steps.expected: Exactly 50

steps.action: Read every question's Polish and English text
steps.expected: Each has a question and exactly one answer, non-empty, in both languages

tests.title: Every 3+ question is at most 100 characters and every answer at most 60

steps.action: Measure every question of the 3+ deck, in Polish and in English
steps.expected: None is longer than 100 characters

steps.action: Measure every answer, in Polish and in English
steps.expected: None is longer than 60 characters

tests.title: Each kind of content appears at least 5 times in the 3+ deck

steps.action: Read the kind of every 3+ question
steps.expected: Each is educational, popular-science, nature or trivia

steps.action: Count the questions of each kind
steps.expected: Each kind appears at least 5 times

tests.title: The age-suitability check of every 3+ question is recorded

steps.action: Find each 3+ question's row in the record
steps.expected: Every question has a row

steps.action: Compare each row with the question it names
steps.expected: The row shows that question and its answer

steps.action: Read each row's four checks: known words, nothing frightening, one answer, verifiable
steps.expected: All four are `pass` for every question

tests.title: All automatic content checks pass; breaking any one fails the suite

steps.action: Run the content checks on every deck the app ships
steps.expected: They report nothing

steps.action: Run them on copies of the 3+ deck, each broken in one way: a question fewer or more than 50, a missing, empty or doubled answer, a missing question text, a question of 101 or an answer of 61 characters, a kind with fewer than 5 questions, an unknown kind, no id, an empty illustration name, a wrong schema version
steps.expected: Each broken copy is reported

steps.action: Run them on decks sharing a question id or a category
steps.expected: Reported

steps.action: Run them on a copy whose question carries an illustration file name
steps.expected: Nothing reported

tests.title: Adding a question or an age category changes content data only

steps.action: List the deck files in the content data and the decks the app ships
steps.expected: Every deck file is shipped, and nothing else

steps.action: Read every screen's source
steps.expected: No screen reads a deck file or holds a question text

steps.action: Read the content checks
steps.expected: They name no category, so a new deck is checked without a code change

tests.title: All content ships inside the app; nothing is downloaded

steps.action: Read the content code
steps.expected: No network call and no remote address

steps.action: Read the release APK's embedded JavaScript bundle
steps.expected: Every 3+ question id, question and answer, in Polish and English, is in it
